item.title: Random black screen with white ‘login’ prompt repeatedly appearing whilst using VM
item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
Kicksecure can be run directly on physical hardware, and can be used as a host for Kicksecure VMs. Vanilla Debian 13 should also work. If you’re already using Kicksecure or Debian on the host, the OS likely isn’t an issue, although an application installed on the host might be the problem in which case a reinstall may fix things.

Trying a different computer would be useful. Since other hardware seems to be working, it’s hard to suggest which component to replace, so I would try using an entirely different computer if you have one available already. (You could also try removing half the RAM from the system to see if the issue is in the removed half of the RAM modules, then try swapping the removed and remaining RAM sticks if the issue persists.)

item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
zzgg:

I gave more thought about the apps with widgets; would it be possible running Mullvad vpn on the main host could cause these login screen errors as the same error is present across all VMs? (both kicksecure and whonix operating systems). I’ve tried to replicate the error before launching Mullvad VPN on main host but cannot.

I mean, very very technically it could be possible, and I’ve seen weird things like this before (KVM virtual machines dying and all Chromium-based applications suddenly misbehaving very badly at the same time, multiple times), but Mullvad VPN on the host shouldn’t have any effect on how graphics libraries work inside VMs. Are you using a Chromium-based browser on the host, and just happen to not use it when Mullvad VPN is off? Maybe that’s somehow having an effect.

item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
Hmm. You’re seeing a segfault, not an illegal instruction error, so this is kind of a long shot, but can you try removing gather_data_sampling=force from the kernel command line and see if that solves the issue? That particular kernel parameter causes random crashes on some hardware but not on other hardware. See:

Kicksecure – 13 May 26

Temporary Kernel Boot Parameter Change - grub bootloader Configuration Changes

Kernel Boot Parameter Changes

item.title: Random black screen with white ‘login’ prompt repeatedly appearing whilst using VM
item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
Did you set up the VM according to the instructions at:

Kicksecure – 24 Sep 26

Kicksecure for KVM

Kicksecure for KVM

If not, you may want to recreate the VM following those instructions.

Did you make any other customizations to the VM’s graphics configuration, like changing to an emulated graphics card other than “virtio”? If so, undo those changes and see if that makes things better.

It’s theoretically possible SimpleX could be the culprit. What you might try is: clone the VM, uninstall SimpleX from the clone, then use the clone for everything but SimpleX, and use the original only for SimpleX. if the VM with SimpleX running crashes, and the one without SimpleX doesn’t crash, then you know that SimpleX is almost certainly at fault.

item.title: Random black screen with white ‘login’ prompt repeatedly appearing whilst using VM
item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
libgallium is part of the graphics stack, specifically part of Mesa3D. Some questions:

  • What host OS are you using?
  • Are you running any third-party applications that create “widgets” or similar things on the screen?
  • Did this only start happening after a software update?
  • Do you have the 3d acceleration checkbox in virt-manager checked? (It shouldn’t be checked, it’s possible this could happen if you checked it.)
